lines.en: label beachvacation14:
I can feel myself getting lost on the way to-
lines.zh: 我能感觉到自己在去的路上迷路了——

lines.en: Where was I going again?
lines.zh: 我刚才要去哪儿来着？

lines.en: scene amibreak1
Rin splits apart from me on the way to [[redacted] and I find myself crawling after a matter of minutes.
lines.zh: Rin在去[已编辑] 的路上和我分开，几分钟后我发现自己几乎是在爬。

lines.en: Or at least doing something that resembles crawling.
lines.zh: 或者至少在做一件类似于爬的事。

lines.en: I lose control of my limbs because of how hard it is to move your body through sand and wind up finding solace leaning up against a tree.
lines.zh: 我控制不住四肢，因为在沙子里挪动身体实在太费劲，最后靠在一棵树上找到了慰藉。

lines.en: The tree looked something like this.
lines.zh: 那棵树大概长这样。

lines.en: scene tree1
Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不对。

lines.en: That isn’t right.
lines.zh: 这样不对。

lines.en: This tree was happier.
lines.zh: 这棵树更快乐一些。

lines.en: scene tree2
That’s better.
lines.zh: 这就对了。

lines.en: So the tree looks like this, but it feels just like any other tree.
lines.zh: 所以这棵树长这样，但摸起来和别的树没什么两样。

lines.en: It has the branches, leaves, the wide part at the bottom that I forget the name of-
lines.zh: 它有树枝、树叶、底下那圈我忘了叫什么名字的粗大部分——

lines.en: And roots.
lines.zh: 还有根。

lines.en: The roots sprawl out underground like a labyrinth, stealing nutrients from wherever it can find them, which I imagine is pretty hard on a beach.
lines.zh: 根像迷宫一样在地下蔓延，从任何能找到养分的地方偷取养分，我想在海滩上这可够难的。

lines.en: All that’s here is sand.
lines.zh: 这里只有沙子。

lines.en: And stars.
lines.zh: 还有星星。

lines.en: And oh how beautiful the stars are tonight.
lines.zh: 还有今晚的星星有多美啊。

lines.en: They make me forget, if even for a moment, how hard it is to move.
lines.zh: 它们让我忘记——哪怕只有一瞬间——挪动有多艰难。

lines.en: How hard it is to breathe.
lines.zh: 呼吸有多艰难。

lines.en: How hard it all is.
lines.zh: 一切都多艰难。

lines.en: And no. Not a penis joke.
lines.zh: 而且不。这不是鸡巴梗。

lines.en: Lol. Come on. You really think I’d joke at a time like this?
lines.zh: 哈哈。拜托。你真觉得我会在这种时候开玩笑？

lines.en: scene tree3
{s}WHO WOULD JOKE AT A TIME LIKE THIS?{/s}
lines.zh: {s}谁会在这种时候开玩笑啊？{/s}

lines.en: {s}THIS IS VACATION!{/s}
lines.zh: {s}这可是度假！{/s}

lines.en: {s}THE HAPPIEST POSSIBLE TIME{/s}
lines.zh: {s}最快乐的时光{/s}

lines.en: So why is everything breaking?
lines.zh: 那为什么一切都在崩坏？

lines.en: : Come to the shoreline.
lines.zh: : 到海岸线来。

lines.en: : Reach for salvation.
lines.zh: : 伸手去够救赎。

lines.en: : Reach for anything you can grab hold of.
lines.zh: : 伸手去够任何你抓得住的东西。

lines.en: : {s}Unless it’s me.{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}只要不是我。{/s}

lines.en: scene whygodwhy
scene whereareyou
scene whythesky
scene mayabeach1
A GIRL STANDS {s}ALONE{/s} ON THE BEACH WITH HER HANDS CLASPED IN PRAYER POSITION.
lines.zh: 一个女孩{s}独自{/s}站在海滩上，双手合十，摆出祈祷的姿势。

lines.en: But why would someone who despises {s}GOD{/s} praying so much be doing just that at a time like this?
lines.zh: 可一个如此憎恨「{s}神{/s}」的人，为什么会在这种时候做出这种举动？

lines.en: : [[redacted prayer. god is real.]
lines.zh: : [已编辑的祷告。神是真实的。]

lines.en: I can’t understand a word coming out of the girl’s mouth.
lines.zh: 女孩嘴里说的，我一个字都听不懂。

lines.en: It’s all foreign to me.
lines.zh: 对我来说全是外语。

lines.en: I had no idea Maya spoke another language.
lines.zh: 我不知道Maya还会说另一种语言。

lines.en: That’s what’s happening, right?
lines.zh: 就是这么回事，对吧？

lines.en: She’s speaking another language!
lines.zh: 她在说另一门语言！

lines.en: You’re so talented, Maya!
lines.zh: 你真是多才多艺啊，Maya！

lines.en: : I can hear you breathing, you know.
lines.zh: : 我能听见你的呼吸声，你知道的。

lines.en: scene mayabeach2
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Are...
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Huh? It’s not like you to ask something like that.
lines.zh: : 哈？这可不像你会问的话。

lines.en: : Are you actually worried about me for once?
lines.zh: : 你居然有一次真的在担心我？

lines.en: scene mayabeach3
: Not anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不担心了。

lines.en: : You just seemed different for a second.
lines.zh: : 只是刚才有那么一瞬间，你看起来不太一样。

lines.en: : Yeah well...it hasn’t really been the best day.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……今天确实不太顺。

lines.en: : I see that. You look like you’ve been through a lot.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。你看起来像是经历了很多事。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: You don’t even know the half of it.
lines.zh: : 你连一半都不知道。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well-
lines.zh: : 是吗，那个——

lines.en: : How is Ayane?
lines.zh: : Ayane怎么样？

lines.en: {i}Does{/i} she know the half of it?
lines.zh: 她{i}知道{/i}一半吗？

lines.en: : Why do you ask that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : She didn’t look so great when she came back from the inn. I wonder what could have possibly happened in there?
lines.zh: : 她从旅馆回来的时候脸色不太好。我真想知道里面到底发生了什么？

lines.en: : You weren’t in the room as well...were you?
lines.zh: : 你当时不在房间里……对吧？

lines.en: : Not this time.
lines.zh: : 这次不在。

lines.en: : But I’m pretty sure I can guess what happened.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概猜得到发生了什么。

lines.en: : I’d very much appreciate it if you didn’t guess.
lines.zh: : 你要是不猜，我会非常感激。

lines.en: : I’d very much appreciate not having to speak of something so utterly horrifying.
lines.zh: : 不用我去提起那么令人作呕的事，我也会非常感激。

lines.en: else:
: I really have...
lines.zh: : 我真的有……

lines.en: : Is there anything not involving [teenage]girls on your mind that you'd like to discuss?
lines.zh: : 你脑子里有没有什么跟[teenage]girls无关的事想聊聊？

lines.en: : Wait, you actually want to talk to me?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的想跟我说话？

lines.en: scene mayabeach4
: The stars are beautiful tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚的星星很美。

lines.en: : They’ve put me in a good mood.
lines.zh: : 它们让我心情不错。

lines.en: : And I thought that maybe I might be able to stand a brief conversation with you.
lines.zh: : 我在想，也许自己能忍受和你短暂地聊上几句。

lines.en: : But if that’s too much to ask, I’d be happy to find something else to do.
lines.zh: : 不过要是这个要求太过分，我很乐意去找点别的事做。

lines.en: : No way. I’ve gotta seize this opportunity while I have it.
lines.zh: : 不行。我得趁现在抓住这个机会。

lines.en: : Something happened right before coming here that's still on my mind. I guess it does involve a [teenage]girl, though.
lines.zh: : 来这儿之前发生了一件事，我现在还在想。不过我想那确实跟一个[teenage]女生有关。

lines.en: : Shocker.
lines.zh: : 真令人震惊。

lines.en: : You made another girl cry, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 我猜，你又把哪个女生弄哭了？

lines.en: : Well...yes. But probably not for the reasons you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。不过原因大概跟你想的不一样。

lines.en: : Does it really matter {i}how{/i} you made them cry? The point is that you did.
lines.zh: : 你{i}怎么{/i}把人弄哭的，真的重要吗？重点是你确实弄哭了。

lines.en: : Not everyone is made to be broken, you know. I’d be careful if I were you.
lines.zh: : 不是所有人都生来就该被摧毁的，你知道吧。我要是你的话会小心点。

lines.en: : Well, I mean...It’s not like I {i}really{/i} need to be careful, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我的意思是……我也不是{i}真的{/i}需要小心，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayabeach5
: I try to give you a warning and that’s your response?
lines.zh: : 我好心给你个警告，你就这么回应？

lines.en: : Maybe I {i}will{/i} find something else to do after all.
lines.zh: : 那我{i}还是{/i}去找点别的事做吧。

lines.en: : No, I just meant that nothing’s really permanent. Right?
lines.zh: : 不，我只是想说，没有什么真正是永久的。对吧？

lines.en: : There are plenty of things that are permanent.
lines.zh: : 永久的东西多了去了。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what you’re getting at.
lines.zh: : 我不明白你想说什么。

lines.en: : I’m talking about your reset button or whatever it is.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你的重置按钮，或者管它叫什么。

lines.en: : Can’t you just fix whatever you don’t like?
lines.zh: : 你不是可以随便把不喜欢的东西修好吗？

lines.en: : Clearly not if you’re still here.
lines.zh: : 显然不行——不然你也不会还在这儿。

lines.en: : Okay, so you can’t get rid of people. But you can get rid of pain or memories or things like that, can’t you?
lines.zh: : 好吧，所以你没法把人弄走。可你总能把痛苦、记忆之类的东西弄走吧？

lines.en: scene mayabeach6
: I think you might be misunderstanding something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能误会了什么。

lines.en: : I’m not the one resetting anything.
lines.zh: : 重置什么的不是我在做。

lines.en: : I’m just asking someone else to do it.
lines.zh: : 我只是请别人去做而已。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I can do it whenever or however I want either.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不是想什么时候、按什么方式都行。

lines.en: : There are some things that work and some things that don’t work.
lines.zh: : 有些事行得通，有些事行不通。

lines.en: : But why are you bringing that up now?
lines.zh: : 不过你现在提这个干嘛？

lines.en: : There are still several months left until we need to worry about that again.
lines.zh: : 离下次需要操心这事还有好几个月呢。

lines.en: : Just focus on enjoying your time here until that happens.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，专心享受你在这儿的时间就好。

lines.en: : I’m confused...
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了……

lines.en: scene mayabeach7
: You’re always confused. How did you even become a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你一直都很糊涂。你到底是怎么当上老师的？

lines.en: : Beats me. Could you maybe reset me into a different job whenever the next time rolls around?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。下次的时候，你能不能把我重置成干别的工作？

lines.en: : You know you could always just quit if you don’t want to do it anymore...I wouldn’t complain.
lines.zh: : 你要是不想干，随时可以辞职啊……我不会有意见的。

lines.en: : But think about how much good I’m doing for the other girls.
lines.zh: : 可你想想我给其他女生带来了多少好处。

lines.en: scene mayabeach8
: I’d rather not think about your relationships with any of the girls, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我宁愿不去想你和任何一个女生的关系。

lines.en: : Quite frankly, I find it abhorrent.
lines.zh: : 坦白讲，我觉得那令人作呕。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how poor Ami must have felt coming into your room to wake you up this morning.
lines.zh: : 我简直能想象，Ami今早进你房间叫你起床时，心里有多难受。

lines.en: To be fair, I think she felt pretty good...
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我觉得她当时感觉挺好的……

lines.en: But again, why does Maya know something like that?
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，Maya为什么会知道这种事？

lines.en: : The way you say that makes it sound like you were waiting around for her.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得，好像你一直在旁边等她似的。

lines.en: scene mayabeach7
: Because I was, you idiot.
lines.zh: : 因为我确实在等啊，你这个白痴。

lines.en: : I don’t know what she is to you, but to me, she’s my best friend.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她对你来说算什么，但对我来说，她是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: scene mayabeach8
: And I’d never do something to betray her trust.
lines.zh: : 而我绝不会做任何背叛她信任的事。

lines.en: : Not even something as simple as eating breakfast without her.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是不等她一起吃早饭这种小事。

lines.en: : What a dedicated and wonderful friend you are...
lines.zh: : 你真是个又忠诚又了不起的朋友啊……

lines.en: scene mayabeach4
: How do you feel about the stars, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你觉得星星怎么样？

lines.en: : The stars? Why are you asking?
lines.zh: : 星星？为什么问这个？

lines.en: : It’s a test of sorts, so answer honestly.
lines.zh: : 算是种测试吧，所以老实回答。

lines.en: : Like...right now? Or in general?
lines.zh: : 是……说现在？还是一般来说？

lines.en: : In general.
lines.zh: : 一般来说。

lines.en: : They’re...fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 它们……还行吧，我觉得。

lines.en: : Just fine?
lines.zh: : 只是还行？

lines.en: : I think so. I haven’t really thought much of it. You need to let me study if you’re going to give me random tests like this.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。我还真没怎么想过这个。你要是打算随便给我出这种测试，可得让我先复习复习。

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. You passed.
lines.zh: : 不，这样就好。你通过了。

lines.en: : Congratulations.
lines.zh: : 恭喜。

lines.en: : What kind of test was that?...
lines.zh: : 这算什么测试啊？……

lines.en: scene mayabeach8
: One that doesn’t matter much to you, but means everything to someone else.
lines.zh: : 一种对你来说无关紧要，对别人来说却意味着一切的测试。

lines.en: : Do you believe in god, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你信神吗？

lines.en: : Some say that god is out there among the stars, watching over everything we do.
lines.zh: : 有人说，神就在那群星之中，注视着我们做的一切。

lines.en: : Those people are wrong, of course. But it’s still a thing they say, regardless.
lines.zh: : 那些人当然是错的。可不管怎样，他们还是这么说。

lines.en: scene mayabeach4
: Do you find blind faith like that in accordance with how you live {i}your{/i} life?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这种盲目的信仰，和{i}你的{/i}人生方式相符吗？

lines.en: : Is there something that you inherently believe in despite the odds being stacked heavily against you?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么东西，是哪怕胜算渺茫，你依然本能地相信的？

lines.en: : Or are you the type to not believe anything unless you see it?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你是那种非亲眼所见就不信的人？

lines.en: : Is this another test?
lines.zh: : 这又是一个测试？

lines.en: : Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 也许是。

lines.en: : Well I think I’m going to fail this one because there are a lot of things I’ve been seeing lately that I {i}still{/i} don’t believe.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我这次大概要不及格了，因为最近我看到很多东西，却{i}依然{/i}不相信。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: scene mayabeach9
: I was the same at one point.
lines.zh: : 我曾经也是这样。

lines.en: : It took me a very long time to come up with the theories and outlooks I have now. Which is probably why they confuse you so greatly.
lines.zh: : 我花了很长时间，才形成现在这些理论和观点。大概也正因如此，它们才让你如此困惑。

lines.en: : Okay, save the backhanded insults for the classroom.
lines.zh: : 好了，这种拐弯抹角的挖苦留到课堂上再说。

lines.en: scene mayabeach10
: But the thing about the stars, especially on nights like this, is that they make all of those theories of mine almost float away in a sense.
lines.zh: : 可是星星这东西，尤其是在这样的夜晚，会让我那些理论在某种意义上几乎飘散不见。

lines.en: : It makes me think, “If there are things this beautiful...anything is possible.”
lines.zh: : 它会让我觉得，「既然存在这么美的东西……那什么都有可能。」

lines.en: : It defies all logic. It defies all reason. But I still believe it while my head is raised.
lines.zh: : 它违背一切逻辑，违背一切理性。可只要我抬着头，我就依然相信。

lines.en: scene mayabeach11
: Of course, those feelings go away as soon as I close my eyes.
lines.zh: : 当然，一闭上眼，那些感觉就消失了。

lines.en: : But for a brief moment in this seemingly infinite timeline, I doubt nothing.
lines.zh: : 但在这看似无限的时间线上，有那么短暂的一瞬，我什么都不怀疑。

lines.en: : So with that in mind, does your opinion of the stars change?
lines.zh: : 那么想到这一点，你对星星的看法改变了吗？

lines.en: : Or do you still just think they’re fine?
lines.zh: : 还是说你依然只觉得它们「还行」？

lines.en: : Honestly, I still just think they’re fine.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我依然只觉得它们还行。

lines.en: scene mayabeach12
: Then you pass again. Two victories in one night.
lines.zh: : 那你又通过了。一晚上两连胜。

lines.en: : This must be a new record for you.
lines.zh: : 这对你来说肯定是个新纪录。

lines.en: : It will never cease to amaze me how carelessly you carry on despite not having a single thing you love.
lines.zh: : 明明没有任何一件热爱的事物，却还能这么没心没肺地活下去，我永远都会为此感到惊奇。

lines.en: : Is that a compliment?
lines.zh: : 这是在夸我吗？

lines.en: scene mayabeach13
: Quite the opposite, actually. It’s repulsive.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。这令人反感。

lines.en: : But still intriguing.
lines.zh: : 不过依然耐人寻味。

lines.en: : I wonder how long you’ll be able to carry that weight for?
lines.zh: : 我想知道，你还能扛着那份重量走多久？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that there’s only so much your mind is able to hold.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你的大脑能承载的东西是有限的。

lines.en: : Memories persist through resets.
lines.zh: : 记忆会穿过重置留存下来。

lines.en: : Well, most of the time at least.
lines.zh: : 至少大多数时候是这样。

lines.en: : Our physical forms may revert to the way they were months prior, so things like scars and even graver injuries can be wiped away.
lines.zh: : 我们的肉体也许会回到几个月前的样子，所以伤疤、甚至更重的伤都能被抹去。

lines.en: : But the things we see and the things we hear do not.
lines.zh: : 可我们看到的东西、听到的东西不会。

lines.en: : Tell me, did you find it strange that everything remained exactly the same when we met again in front of the bistro?
lines.zh: : 我问你，当初我们在小餐馆前重逢，一切都原封不动，你不觉得奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s not like you didn’t warn me beforehand. I just still don’t understand {i}why{/i}.
lines.zh: : 奇怪，不过你事先也提醒过我了。我只是到现在还不明白{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s normal. Neither do I.
lines.zh: : 这很正常。我也不明白。

lines.en: : Well, can’t you just ask whoever is resetting the world then?
lines.zh: : 那你就不能去问问重置世界的那个人吗？

lines.en: : You can ask anyone anything, but it doesn’t mean you’ll ever get an answer.
lines.zh: : 你想问谁什么都可以，可不代表你会得到答案。

lines.en: scene mayabeach14
: There are some things that people dedicate their entire lives to discovering.
lines.zh: : 有些东西，人们花上一辈子去探寻。

lines.en: : But you and I...and everyone else in the class-
lines.zh: : 可你和我……还有班上其他所有人——

lines.en: : We have a little more time than that.
lines.zh: : 我们拥有的时间比那要多一点。

lines.en: : So what are we to do with it all?
lines.zh: : 那我们该拿这些时间做什么呢？

lines.en: : Sit around and endlessly enjoy our youth?
lines.zh: : 坐着无所事事，无休止地享受青春吗？

lines.en: : How many years worth of memories can we fit into such short time periods without going absolutely insane?
lines.zh: : 在那短短的时间里，我们究竟能塞进多少年的记忆，才不会彻底发疯？

lines.en: : It will all come tumbling down one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，一切都会轰然倒塌。

lines.en: : You may have your questions, but I have mine too.
lines.zh: : 你有你的疑问，我也有我的。

lines.en: : So the next time you suggest that nothing is permanent, keep in mind that some things very much are.
lines.zh: : 所以下次你再说「没有什么是永久的」时，请记住：有些东西非常永久。

lines.en: : Some things are too permanent.
lines.zh: : 有些东西永久得过头了。

lines.en: scene mayabeach15
: That’s all I wanted to say.
lines.zh: : 我想说的就这些。

lines.en: As always, I’m not really sure what to say to Maya.
lines.zh: 一如既往，我真不知道该对Maya说什么。

lines.en: Until now, I’ve been trying not to think much about the whole ‘reset’ thing...
lines.zh: 在此之前，我一直尽量不去想「重置」这件事……

lines.en: But it seems like Maya has been thinking about it for quite a while.
lines.zh: 不过看起来，Maya已经想了很久了。

lines.en: I wonder how many times she’s reset by now?
lines.zh: 不知道她到现在重置了多少次？

lines.en: scene black
And I wonder-
lines.zh: 而我想知道——

lines.en: How many more resets will there be until I’m gone?
lines.zh: 还要再重置多少次，我才会消失？

lines.en: How easily can someone else steal back the body I stole myself?
lines.zh: 别人要夺回我这具偷来的身体，有多容易？

lines.en: I close my eyes and cling to Maya’s words.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，紧紧抓住Maya的话。

lines.en: Some things are too permanent.
lines.zh: 有些东西永久得过头了。

lines.en: And I think about praying, for the first time in my life-
lines.zh: 而我第一次想到要祈祷——

lines.en: That I am one of those things.
lines.zh: 祈祷自己也是其中之一。
